Container.Name: dropwatch
Container.Overview:
Dropwatch earns Twitch Drops for you in the background and claims each reward as soon as it's earned.
**What it does** - Picks which campaign to watch, and moves to another channel when a stream goes offline - Collects channel points and watch-streak bonuses on your favourite channels - Lists anything that needs you, such as a game account to link - Web dashboard for priorities, skipped games, pinned campaigns and history, phone included - Optional notifications to Discord, Telegram, ntfy, Slack, Pushover, Gotify or any webhook
**Getting started** Open the WebUI, choose a page password, then sign in to Twitch with a one-time code. One Twitch account per container.
Container.Changes:
### 0.3.0 (2026-11-10) - New: Channel points. Add streamers on the new Points tab and Dropwatch watches them whenever they're live, drops or not, so their points and bonus chests pile up while you're away. Twitch counts two streams at once: one goes to drops while there's a campaign to mine, the rest to your list, top first. - The Points tab shows who's being watched, who's waiting for a free stream, and what each streamer earned in the last 30 days. Drag streamers to reorder them. - Add boxes take a full twitch.tv link as well as a name, check the channel with Twitch when you leave the box, and suggest the closest matches once you've typed 3 letters.
### 0.2.0 (2026-10-12) - New: Priority-only mining. Turn it on in Settings › Mining to mine only the games in your Priority list; everything else waits until you switch it off. - Overview tells you when there's nothing to mine in your Priority games, and folds the other campaigns into one line you can open. - History shows campaigns missed while Priority only was on. - Notices: errors stay up longer, Alt+N jumps to the newest notice so Undo works from the keyboard, and each Dismiss button says what it closes. - Settings: the weekly summary shows its time zone. - Mining moves on as soon as a stream ends.
### 0.1.1 (2026-10-11) - First release in Community Applications, published by KernelPanic Studios. - Mines Twitch Drops in the background and claims each reward as soon as it's earned. - Collects channel points and watch-streak bonuses on favourite channels. - Web dashboard: what's being mined, what's next, priorities, history and a phone layout. - Needs you: campaigns that need a game account linked, with an Ignore option. - Notifications to Discord, Telegram, ntfy, Slack, Pushover, Gotify or any webhook. - Backup and restore of lists and settings.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where Dropwatch keeps its database (Twitch sign-in, lists, history) and cached images.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Dropwatch web UI.

Config.Name: Allowed host names
Config.Description: Only needed to open Dropwatch through a public domain name, such as a reverse proxy (dropwatch.example.com). Comma-separated. IP addresses and local names like tower or tower.local always work.

Config.Name: Reverse proxy address
Config.Description: Only behind a reverse proxy: its address, so the login lockout sees each visitor's own address.
